description: This is a Java service class 'UserService' responsible for managing user-related operations within the internet banking application. It handles user creation, retrieval, and updates, integrating with external services like Keycloak and the banking core, as well as repository persistence.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class providing user management functionalities such as create, read, and update users, integrating with Keycloak, banking core, and database repositories.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user after validating email and identification, integrates with Keycloak for user registration, and persists the user data in the database.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users from the database, enriching each with current Keycloak user info.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a specific user by ID from the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates the user's status and enables Keycloak user if status is approved.
